name: Eurocopter EC130 B4
summary: Single-engine light helicopter with a wide cabin and a Fenestron tail, a favorite for sightseeing tours thanks to its quiet tail and big windows.

verify.note: A three-blade rotor never spans its full 10.69 m diameter side to side, so the measured width is about 87% of it. The model measures 3.88 m tall against the published 3.61 m.

tail-rotor.Type: Fenestron with unevenly spaced blades for lower noise
